correctness.rationale: PASS: Perfectness means GL_n(q), making squares independent. From the centroid identities T(e_i)e_j=e_iT(e_j) for distinct i,j, all off-diagonal T entries vanish, and M_ij(t_j−t_i)=0 forces scalar constants on each weak support component. Blocks correspond exactly to indecomposable ideals. Counting the component containing label 1 proves the c_n and h_{n,k} recurrences and exponential formula; block-size partition gives N_λ. Bonferroni for singleton components and a union bound over blocks of size 2..floor(n/2) give sharp probability a_n. Independent exhaustive GL4(F2) count (19446,683,30,1), and GL3(F3) (10960,264,8), matched recurrences. The universal asymptotic follows from the analytic union bounds, not finite tests.
